newsitem.title: MADAGASCAR: Madagascar finds 500 who went missing in storm.
newsitem.headline: Madagascar finds 500 who went missing in storm.

text.p: Five hundred people missing after a storm hit the northwest of Madagascar at the weekend have all been found safe and sound, radio Madagascar reported on Thursday.
It said the missing people had climbed up to higher ground after the storm and as water levels dropped they had come back down from their places of refuge.
The government said on Wednesday that floodwaters reached 3.6 metres (12 feet) high when rivers burst their banks and a total of 500 people were missing and 34 were confirmed dead.
Population Minister Daniel Ramaromisa, government spokesman, also said considerable damage was caused by tropical depression Josie which dumped large amounts of rain on the vanilla-growing northwest.
Josie struck in the northwest of the island as work was under way in the southeast to feed and shelter the homeless from Cyclone Gretelle, which hit between January 24 and 26.
